# Unitec USA Design

> Unitec USA Design is a premier Miami-based manufacturer and wholesale distributor of high-performance architectural materials, specializing in PVC sheets, WPC (Wood-Plastic Composite) decking and wall cladding, and SPC (Stone Plastic Composite) flooring. Engineered for zero maintenance, high UV resistance, and full recyclability, Unitec supplies developers, architects, and contractors across North America, Latin America, and the Caribbean via full-container direct-factory logistics.

## Core Products & Collections

- [Exterior Solutions](https://unitecusadesign.com/colecciones/exterior/): Exterior PVC cladding, WPC architectural louvers, weatherproof facades, and UV-resistant outdoor decking.
- [Interior Design Solutions](https://unitecusadesign.com/colecciones/interior/): Acoustic panels, decorative PVC marble-finish sheets, 3D wall claddings, and ceiling systems.
- [WPC Paneling & Cladding](https://unitecusadesign.com/colecciones/paneles-wpc/): Wood-plastic composite panels for moisture resistance and termite-proof indoor/outdoor architectural applications.
- [SPC Flooring](https://unitecusadesign.com/colecciones/pisos/): High-density stone-plastic composite rigid core flooring with acoustic underlayment.
- [Artificial Gardens & Green Walls](https://unitecusadesign.com/colecciones/jardines-artificiales/): Premium biophilic vertical gardens, UV-stabilized artificial foliage for commercial and residential spaces.
- [Full Product Catalog](https://unitecusadesign.com/colecciones/): Complete listing of 330+ architectural SKUs, dimensional specifications, and wholesale bundles.

## Logistics & Business Model

- [Logistics Laboratory](https://unitecusadesign.com/laboratorio-logistico/): Container optimization methodology, palletizing simulations, and freight cost mitigation.
- [Container Selection](https://unitecusadesign.com/seleccion-de-contenedores/): Interactive 20ft and 40ft container capacity calculator for wholesale buyers.
- [Business Models](https://unitecusadesign.com/nosotros/business-models/): Direct factory-to-port import models, wholesale pricing tiers, and regional distribution partnerships.
